text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Urgh… This isn't right, and neither is this!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Oh, hi Trainer! I'm trying to make an original spice blend!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: It's still missing a little something, but I just can't tell what! I've been trying to figure it out for ages!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Guh! What can it be? What's the missing spice?! I won't be able to rest until I find the answer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono is so fixated on perfecting her spice blend that she doesn't seem capable of concentrating on anything else…
